## Context / Problem

Under heavy multi-session load (~20 concurrent rebar CLI processes sharing the one tracker),
`rebar show airborne-wellloved-kingfisher` (epic 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a, 23 children) produced
ZERO output for >200 s across two attempts (killed at 75 s and 211 s), while
`rebar list --parent 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a` — a strictly larger payload (778.6 KB) — completed
in ~67 s, and every invocation logged `rebar.llm.enrich_drain` gate-check overruns (339-3589 ms
vs a 20 ms budget). Root cause is CONFIRMED (see the RCA comment, 2026-08-22): the default
`rebar show` arm attaches `plan_review_health` (src/rebar/_engine_support/reads_cli.py:206),
whose pin derivation calls, per plan-material pin,
`current_material_fingerprint_impl` → `live_material_children`
(src/rebar/llm/plan_review/relation_snapshot.py:299) → `_reads.list_tickets(parent=<pin>)` →
`reduce_all_tickets` — a FULL-STORE reduction per pin, ×4 for stale pins via
`_legacy_material_ok` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:679). Measured on the real store
(5247 tickets): 89 full-store scans, 466,983 single-ticket reduces, 745 s for ONE
`plan_review_health` call; `list --parent` does exactly 1 scan (9.1 s in the same window).
The enrich-drain gate overrun is a separate, bounded mechanism split out to
6148-5d81-8e80-41e8 (linked discovered_from).

## Approach

Collapse the O(pins × 4) full-store scans to one shared snapshot per derivation, without
changing any verdict semantics. Add a ContextVar-scoped child-index snapshot to
`rebar.llm.plan_review.relation_snapshot`: a context manager (`material_child_index()`) that,
while active, makes `live_material_children` answer from a parent_id→children index built ONCE
from a single unfiltered `_reads.list_tickets(include_archived=True, …)` pass (same
`counts_as_plan_material_child` filtering as today, relation_snapshot.py:273-299, so per-parent
results are byte-identical). Activation is idempotent (an outer context wins).
`derive_plan_material_pin_health` (attest.py:54) opens the context around its `derive_health`
call — covering the per-pin fingerprints AND the in-frame `_legacy_material_ok` recomputes —
and `plan_review_health` (src/rebar/audit/read.py:58) opens it around the
verify+compute_validity pair so the whole show-side derivation shares one snapshot. This fits
the problem because the 89 scans are provably identical-argument `reduce_all_tickets` calls
within one derivation (RCA experiment: 89 × 5247 = 466,983 reduces, exact); a bounded
read-scoped snapshot also gives all pins one consistent store view instead of 89 slightly
different ones. No caching survives the call; gates (claim/close/bugfix-size) keep their exact
result contract and merely stop rescanning — all `compute_validity` callers consume the result
dict only (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest_gate.py:141, src/rebar/_commands/gates.py:244,
src/rebar/llm/code_review/bugfix_size_gate.py:255, src/rebar/llm/completion_child_gate.py:110).
The test seam `attest.current_material_fingerprint` (monkeypatched by
tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py, test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py) is untouched.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/relation_snapshot.py — add the `material_child_index()` context
  manager + index-aware fast path in `live_material_children`.
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py — `derive_plan_material_pin_health` opens the context.
- src/rebar/audit/read.py — `plan_review_health` opens the context around its
  verify+compute_validity block.
- tests/unit/test_pin_health_store_scan_count.py — new regression test (RED first).

## Testing

RED-first regression test (tests/unit/test_pin_health_store_scan_count.py): build a scratch
store (git init + `rebar.init_repo`, the tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py `repo`
fixture pattern), create an epic with 4 children plus filler tickets, then call
`compute_validity` with a constructed plan-review attestation carrying 1 pin vs 4 pins (all
with non-matching fingerprints, forcing the ×4 legacy path) while counting
`rebar._engine_support.reads.reduce_all_tickets` invocations via a monkeypatch wrapper.
Failure path (today, RED): the 4-pin run performs strictly more full-store reductions than the
1-pin run (O(pins)). Happy path (after the fix, GREEN): both runs perform the same, constant
number of full-store reductions, and per-pin `live_material_children` results are identical
with and without the snapshot context (equality assertion — the no-drift check). Existing
suites must stay green: tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py,
tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py, tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Root cause confirmed via /rebar-debug (mechanism at file:line, discriminating experiment
      run, caused_by attributed) — DONE, recorded in the RCA comment (89-scan arithmetic match,
      faulthandler stacks, caused_by cb6b-24b4-1056-4ee6 linked).
- [x] The new scan-count test proves full-store reductions per `compute_validity` call do not
      grow with pin count (seen RED before the fix, GREEN after; checked by
      `pytest tests/unit/test_pin_health_store_scan_count.py`).
- [x] `plan_review_health` on epic 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a against the real store completes in the
      same order of magnitude as one `rebar list --parent 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a` (checked by
      re-running the RCA's instrumented timing: scan count drops from 89 to ≤2, wall time from
      ~745 s to within ~10x of the single-scan list time in the same load window).
- [x] Verdict-preservation: tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py,
      tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py and
      tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py pass unchanged (checked by pytest).
- [x] The enrich-drain gate-check overrun has a recorded disposition: mechanism + rationale in
      this ticket's RCA comment, contract decision tracked in 6148-5d81-8e80-41e8
      (discovered_from-linked) — no silent steady state.
